title: Bug: Binary PLY - Wrong texture display

labels.name: Bug
labels.description: Global flag to mark a deviation from expected behaviour

labels.name: PLY
labels.description: Bugs related to the PLY format

body:
**Describe the bug**
When loading some specific binary PLY, the textures displayed are wrong. It seems to use the texture file (which is weird btw) colors but not the correct position.

But it's fine in other 3D viewer soft, like in Exocad or Meshlab.

We notice this bug on several meshes, all coming from the same Intra Oral Scanner company (but not on all meshes).

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

Open this mesh [WrongTexture.zip](https://github.com/assimp/assimp/files/15110397/WrongTexture.zip) into Assimp Viewer, see the wrong texture appear.

Or, try loading it directly with Assimp and notice the wrong texture display.

**Expected behavior**
Correct texture display, like in Exocad or in Meshlab. 

**Screenshots**
In Assimp Viewer (wrong texture)
![assimp_display](https://github.com/assimp/assimp/assets/168069258/1dba7f83-628a-46bd-9715-8e77a8238b68)

In Exocad (perfect texture)
![exocad_display](https://github.com/assimp/assimp/assets/168069258/2e392494-2fc6-43b7-abef-df79b299447f)

In Meshlab(good texture, but with strange red points)
![meshlab_display](https://github.com/assimp/assimp/assets/168069258/7cb7dc34-704e-42f2-8969-6a63dc0bf8f4)


**Platform (please complete the following information):**
 - OS: Windows
 - Version:
    - last version available on master: Assimp 5.4.2077888392 amd64 msvc shared singlethreadedsingle
    - Assimp 5.2.0

**Additional context**
